dedupe_keys.name: comparative analysis of ai based models for short term photovoltaic power forecasting in energy cooperatives

description: Nikos Dimitropoulos and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented comparison evaluates machine-learning and deep-learning models for a solar plant operated by an energy cooperative. Three input-data cases and lagged observations are examined for next-hour generation; the strongest method is also tested at three-, six- and twenty-four-hour horizons. An earlier four-algorithm cooperative study forms a related application in the same research programme, with its shorter forecast scope preserved. Exact sample overlap is not established. These models support renewable-production forecasting with available historical data. The source does not identify a universally best algorithm across all plants or supply a public code package in the inspected metadata. Native metadata gives restricted access and the licence label unknown. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
